name: Kurmanjan Datka
contribution: A Kyrgyz politician who acquiesced under duress to the annexation of that region to Russia.
legacy: Her wisdom and diplomatic skills saved us from death and destruction

checks.lead: Kurmanjan Datka or Datka Kurmanjan Mamatbay kyzy (22 May 1811 – 1 February 1907), also known as the "Tsaritsa of Alai" (Алайская царица) or the "Queen of the South", was a Kyrgyz politician who acquiesced under duress to the annexation of that region to Russia. She was a female tribal leader and nicknamed the Queen.
